Japan's Prime Minister Kishida Reshuffles Cabinet

Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida conducted a significant cabinet reshuffle, appointing new ministers to key positions. The changes aim to boost public support and signal confidence to markets. Sanae Takaichi was among those appointed, with the reshuffle seen as a move to consolidate power and address public approval ratings. The specific portfolios and the implications for policy direction are being closely watched.
